records.definition: Synthetic region assigned to a demo customer profile.
records.mapping_note: Synthetic geography; replace it with a field authorized for your deployment.
records.configuration_guidance: Select a region value from the demo enumeration.
records.usage_guidance: Use as an inclusion filter only when the campaign scope specifies a region.

records.configuration_guidance: Choose one or more demo membership tiers.
records.usage_guidance: Use for tier-specific offers; do not infer purchasing power from a tier.

records.definition: Number of days since the latest completed purchase in the synthetic demo.
records.path: Demo CDP / Purchase / Days since last purchase
records.usage_guidance: Use for lifecycle and dormant-customer strategies.

records.definition: Count of completed purchases during the previous 180 days in the synthetic demo.
records.usage_guidance: Use to distinguish new, low-frequency and frequent demo customers.

records.definition: Synthetic completed-order amount during the previous 180 days.
records.configuration_guidance: Enter an amount in the demo currency.
records.usage_guidance: Use only as a historical purchase measure, not as an income estimate.

records.configuration_guidance: Specify a relative time window and minimum event count.
records.usage_guidance: Use as a recent-interest signal, never as proof of purchase.

records.path: Demo CDP / Events / Add to cart
records.configuration_guidance: Specify a relative time window and minimum event count.
records.usage_guidance: Use as a strong intent signal; it does not guarantee availability or checkout.

records.definition: Synthetic flag indicating registration with zero completed purchases.
records.path: Demo CDP / Lifecycle / Registered without purchase
records.configuration_guidance: Select true for the demo conversion scenario.
records.usage_guidance: Use only when the purchase definition and observation window are documented.

records.definition: Synthetic category preference derived from demo activity.
records.configuration_guidance: Choose one or more demo categories.
records.usage_guidance: Use as a preference signal; do not convert a free-text request into an unsupported code.

records.path: Demo CDP / Store relation / Nearest store
records.configuration_guidance: Choose a store from the synthetic enumeration.
records.usage_guidance: Use only for the demo; do not infer precise distance or residence.

records.configuration_guidance: Include only the granted state for outbound demo scenarios.
records.usage_guidance: Treat consent as a mandatory eligibility condition, not an optimization signal.

records.configuration_guidance: Exclude records matching any configured suppression reason.
records.usage_guidance: Use as an exclusion group with OR semantics.
